profile: perf cpu-clock:u, 997Hz, no callgraph; leaf/self samples; no lost samples in reports
execution: 24 new non-root benchmark processes per profile, each 1 warm-up + 5 timed 1M-iteration memory passes; entire process is sampled
cold_instrumentation: register anonymous RX code in perf-PID.map and query private-page eligibility before execution; no per-memory diagnostic counters added
control: data explicitly materialized before snapshot for both modes; sole actor owns all coordinator handles and View; private admission and eligible data flag asserted
latency: separate unprofiled six alternating pairs for each software engine; not timings collected under perf
scope: single eligible resident private data page; cannot merge with previous default guarded demand-populated cohort; sampling percentages are diagnostic symbol attribution, not exact removable cycle fractions
